subject: Implementation kickoff & MAP for FinTechCo
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Torres <emily.torres@fintechco.com>, Rajiv Singh <rajiv.singh@fintechco.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation kickoff & MAP for FinTechCo

Hi team —

Thanks for the productive call this morning with FinTechCo. As discussed, attaching the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and a strawman SOW so we can align on milestones, owners, and dates. High level summary:

- Goal: Production inference for transaction-scoring model by June 15, 2026.
- Key milestones: Account provisioning & networking (Week 1), Model onboarding & quantization tests (Weeks 2–4), Integration & E2E testing (Weeks 5–8), Pilot & monitoring (Weeks 9–12).
- Primary Redwood owners: Marissa (CS lead) — overall program; Vivek (Onboarding eng) — infra & deployment; Priyom (AE) — commercial/coordination.
- FinTechCo owners: Emily (PM) & Rajiv (SecOps).

Asks for CS before the kickoff:
1) Confirm owners and point-of-contacts for each milestone.
2) Proposed kickoff meeting: Thu Mar 12, 10:00–11:00 PT — can you confirm?
3) Any initial compliance evidence they need (SOC2, retention policies) — tagging security in parallel.

Attachments: FinTechCo-MAP-v1.pdf (MAP with milestones), FinTechCo-SOW-draft.docx.

I can host the kickoff and walk through the MAP; Marissa / Vivek can handle technical intake.

Thanks,
Priyom
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priom_das@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Torres <emily.torres@fintechco.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Implementation kickoff & MAP for FinTechCo

Thanks Priyom — got the MAP and SOW. Quick responses below and a couple of suggested edits inline in the attached PDF.

- Kickoff: Thu Mar 12, 10:00 PT works for me. Monica (onboarding engineer) will join to take notes and capture technical action items.
- Owners: I suggest assigning Vivek as owner for Account Provisioning & Network (M1), Monica for Model Onboarding & Test infra (M2), and myself for Pilot & Monitoring (M4).
- Milestone timing: the June 15 target is reasonable but conservative; propose we move Model Onboarding completion to Apr 5 and E2E testing to May 7 to allow a longer pilot window if needed.
- Deliverables: please add a discrete step for 'Data Access & Sample Exchange' (responsible: FinTechCo — Emily) with a 2-week SLA after kickoff.

CC: Emily — could you confirm your team can provide a 10k-row sample dataset and a service account within two weeks of kickoff? Also looping in Rajiv if there are any early security constraints.

I'll upload my markup to the Drive link after the call.

—Marissa
Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 347-555-0147

Hi all —

Thanks — we reviewed the MAP and the proposed dates look fine in general. A couple of notes from our side:

- Data sample: we can provide a 10k-row anonymized sample by Mar 24, not within two weeks; can this be accommodated?
- Security evidence: Rajiv will need SOC2 Type II audit summary and details on audit logging/retention. Can we get those to him before the kickoff?
- Pilot scope: we prefer a phased pilot (10% traffic shadow -> 50% -> 100%) over a three-week window. Please add an explicit rollback checklist for each phase.

We can confirm kickoff Thu Mar 12, 10:00 PT — will send calendar invite from my side. Attaching a short internal requirements doc (summary) for reference.

Best,

Marissa/Priyom —

Following up after the comments. I uploaded an updated MAP (FinTechCo-MAP-v1.pdf -> v1.1) with the adjusted milestone dates and explicit owners per Marissa's suggestions. Summary of the agreed timeline: 

- M1: Account provisioning & network setup — Owner: Vivek — Target: Mar 19, 2026
- M1a: Service account & IAM config — Owner: Rajiv (FinTechCo) — Target: Mar 24, 2026
- M2: Model onboarding, quantization & validation — Owner: Monica — Target: Apr 5, 2026
- M3: Integration & E2E testing — Owner: Monica/FinTechCo Eng — Target: May 7, 2026
- M4: Pilot (phased) & monitoring — Owner: Marissa — Target: Jun 15, 2026 (pilot complete)

Action items before kickoff (Mar 12):
1) Priyom: confirm contract signature path and whether SOW needs change before kickoff (DocuSign link in related links).
2) Rajiv/FinTechCo: provide SOC2 summary and confirm service account creation timeline (target Mar 24).
3) Monica: prepare test harness and integration checklist; will share by Mar 11 EOD.
4) Marissa: run kickoff agenda and capture open risks (I will add a rollback checklist template to the MAP).

I'll host the technical portion of the kickoff and walk through the infra checklist. If any dates slip we will revise the MAP and communicate asap.

Thanks — see you on Thu.

Vivek Kulkarni
